# Set Next Full DKG Ceremony [validator.setNextFullDkgCeremony]

Sets the next epoch for a full DKG ceremony.

## Usage

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"21089b5716f76ac653bbfc54c085b33c246a602d4200db03ba6af13e452d7462","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const { receipt } = await client.validator.setNextFullDkgCeremonySync({
  epoch: 42n,
})

console.log('Transaction hash:', receipt.transactionHash)
// @log: Transaction hash: 0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a57ef5436b6bcd3f320cc085c065fe4b69419ffb0305348d36e1f041a72ebceb","data":""}
// [!include ~/snippets/tempo/viem.config.ts:setup]
```

:::

### Asynchronous Usage

The examples above use a `*Sync` variant of the action, that will wait for the transaction to be included before returning.

If you are optimizing for performance, you should use the non-sync `validator.setNextFullDkgCeremony` action and wait for inclusion manually:

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"0b64f1c10cf8f9e5c8926ecae705710428a54f6432fbe3c88c2207e3f06269ce","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const hash = await client.validator.setNextFullDkgCeremony({
  epoch: 42n,
})
const receipt = await client.transaction.waitForReceipt({ hash }).receipt
```

## Recipes

### Refresh Key Shares After Removing a Validator

Combine [`validator.changeStatus`](/tempo/actions/validator.changeStatus) with a full ceremony so the remaining set regenerates its key shares at the chosen epoch.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"9af7656668e04861d6e0e2588b93cc4224b0202cbad7d1768e0a98f16b324a9c","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const { receipt } = await client.validator.changeStatusSync({ // [!code focus]
  active: false, // [!code focus]
  validator: '0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f0bEbb',
})

await client.validator.setNextFullDkgCeremonySync({ epoch: 42n }) // [!code focus]
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a57ef5436b6bcd3f320cc085c065fe4b69419ffb0305348d36e1f041a72ebceb","data":""}
// [!include ~/snippets/tempo/viem.config.ts:setup]
```

:::

### Verify the Scheduled Epoch Before Announcing It

Read the schedule back with [`validator.getNextFullDkgCeremony`](/tempo/actions/validator.getNextFullDkgCeremony) before notifying operators of the maintenance window.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a18eda940a99fb1251826848a865a8fe8d30228d38664941cf907ab4b251aaf3","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

await client.validator.setNextFullDkgCeremonySync({ epoch: 42n })

const scheduled = await client.validator.getNextFullDkgCeremony() // [!code focus]

console.log('Ceremony scheduled for epoch:', scheduled)
// @log: Ceremony scheduled for epoch: 42n
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a57ef5436b6bcd3f320cc085c065fe4b69419ffb0305348d36e1f041a72ebceb","data":""}
// [!include ~/snippets/tempo/viem.config.ts:setup]
```

:::

## Return Value

```ts
type ReturnType = {
  /** Transaction receipt. */
  receipt: TransactionReceipt
}
```

The transaction receipt.

## Parameters

### epoch

- **Type:** `bigint`

Epoch number for the next full DKG ceremony.
